fullDescription: F-15J改修機は納入遅延が濃厚、2028年度にも間に合わない可能性  航空万能論GF
sourceData: Google News RSS Ingest: 航空万能論GF (Japan (JA))

steps: Redistribute production curing/smelting loads to active parallel systems.
Dispatch OEM specialized engineering units to rebuild degraded kiln refractories.
Reschedule widebody delivery buffers to smooth line assembly velocity.
mitigationPlan.timeline: 3 to 5 operational days for equipment calibration and liner replacement

steps: Verify temperature and pressure consistency under peak thermal test cycles.
Track system throughput metrics to confirm structural recovery to baseline rates.
validationPlan.timeline: 24 hours of thermal consistency stress profiling

downstreamImpact: Reduced assembly line curing volume, risking final delivery schedules.
mitigationObjective: Maximize parallel capacity run-rates to absorb downtime backlogs.
